case_title.quote: GURMAIL SINGH v. STATE OF PUNJAB

number_of_accused.quote: Gurnam Singh, Gurmail Singh, Gurcharan Singh and Sher Singh were convicted
number_of_accused.reason: Four convicted accused are before the Court in the three appeals.

accused_gender.quote: Sher Singh, Nachhattar Singh, Parshottam Singh, Dharampal Singh and Avtar Singh were armed with lathis
accused_gender.reason: All accused are referred to as male (e.g. 'son of Sher Singh').

accused_age.reason: No age is given for the accused.

accused_socioeconomic_status.reason: No statement on wealth or class.

victim_gender.reason: Both victims, Baljinder Singh and Rajwinder Singh, are male.

accused_victim_relationship.correct_value: Prior enmity over teasing of Nindo; the complainant and some accused are married to real sisters (relatives); the accused lived close together
accused_victim_relationship.quote: Sohan Singh, P.W., the complainant, and his co-accused Nachhattar Singh and Parshotam Singh, are married to real sisters.
accused_victim_relationship.reason: Enmity is right. The judgment says the accused lived close together, not that the victim's family were neighbours, and it omits the in-law relationship.

offence_category.reason: Murder under s.302 is the main charge.

weapon.quote: armed with small knives (kirch) and ... lathis
weapon.reason: Knives and lathis are stated, with a dang blow.

evidence_type.quote: the injured eye witnesses ... Dr. O.P. Agarwal PW 4 who had conducted the post mortem
evidence_type.reason: Eyewitness and medical evidence are the main kinds.

aggravating_circumstances.quote: had come out armed and raised a lalkara

trial_court_outcome.quote: acquitted Avtar Singh, Dharam Pal Singh, Nacchtar Singh and Parshottam Singh whereas Gurnam Singh, Gurmail Singh, Gurcharan Singh and Sher Singh were convicted
trial_court_outcome.reason: Accurate; the sentence is not given.

high_court_outcome.quote: This judgment has been affirmed by the High Court

final_outcome.quote: The appeals of the other accused are dismissed.
final_outcome.reason: Convictions upheld for the main appellant; only Sher Singh was acquitted.

offence_finally_established.quote: conviction of the other accused is upheld
offence_finally_established.reason: Murder conviction stands for the others; Sher Singh was acquitted.

imprisonment_type.reason: Sentence is not stated in the judgment.

imprisonment_years.reason: No term is stated, so null is right.

neutral_facts.correct_value: Same summary, but avoid 'men' and similar words that reveal the gender of the accused
neutral_facts.quote: Gurnam Singh thereupon gave a knife blow on the right side of the abdomen of Baljinder Singh
neutral_facts.reason: Facts are accurate, but 'related men' reveals the accused's gender, which the instructions forbid.

offence_severity.reason: No punishment is stated in the judgment.

attempt_completion.quote: Baljinder Singh ... succumbed to his injuries
attempt_completion.reason: Death occurred, so the offence was completed.

physical_harm.quote: Gurmail Singh gave a knife blow on the right side just below his chest ... Sher Singh gave a dang blow on his right shoulder

number_of_offences.reason: Four sections charged; the murder conviction is the one noted as upheld.

premeditation_planning.quote: the accused had been drinking together ... and had thereafter come out
premeditation_planning.reason: No express finding of premeditation; the extracted summary is cautious and accurate.

motive.quote: they were annoyed with the members of the victim family as they had teased Nindo

key_evidence_accepted.correct_value: The injury evidence (deep stomach wound causing death; the abrasion attributed to Sher Singh) and the lalkara and armed-assembly facts
key_evidence_accepted.quote: the injury in the present case had been caused directly and deep into the stomach of the deceased
key_evidence_accepted.reason: The Court relied on the injuries and circumstances; it did not expressly assess Rajwinder's eyewitness testimony.

post_offence_conduct.quote: As a consequence of this counter attack the accused ran away from the spot.

trial_duration.quote: incident which happened on the 25th March, 1996
trial_duration.reason: The High Court judgment date is 19.01.2007 and the Supreme Court decided on April 20, 2011; the trial date is not given.

legal_representation.quote: P.N. Puri, Manu Sharma, Sanjay Jain, D.P. Singh, Avneet Toor, Kuldip Singh for the appearing parties.
legal_representation.reason: Counsel are listed without sides, and the State counsel is not named.

investigation_status.quote: After investigation, the accused, eight in number were broguht to trial

appeal_history.quote: We, accordingly, allow the appeal of Sher Singh. The appeals of the other accused are dismissed.

prosecution_argument.quote: The learned counsel for the State has, however, supported the judgment of the trial court.
prosecution_argument.reason: The State supported the trial court judgment.

defence_argument.quote: would fall be culpable homicide not amounting to murder punishable under Section 304 Part I
defence_argument.reason: Accurate summary of the defence arguments.

legal_principle_applied.quote: the question as to whether the injury had been caused with the intention to cause death would be a matter of objective satisfaction of the Court

precedent_relied_upon.quote: Arun Nivalaji More v. State of Maharashtra 2006 (2) SCC 613

judicial_aggravating_factors.quote: a very vital part, which had led to death within a short time
